title: Micro-Lens: Compact Model & Route Performance Tiles with Token Attribution Flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, embeddable "micro-lens" UI that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency distributions, throughput, token usage and cost attribution) in a single small footprint suitable for lists, rollouts, and on-demand rail panels. The micro-lens should provide a quick health summary, a small set of actionable charts, and a clear path to drill into the full model/route performance page. This ticket covers wireframes, chart specs, interaction patterns, accessibility considerations, and a high-fidelity prototype for UX review.
background: Product wants a lightweight view that can be embedded in the routes list, rollout toasts, and dedicated model cards. Existing larger canvases are too dense for rapid triage during incidents and for PD/SE daily check-ins. The micro-lens must show core KPI at-a-glance and allow context-preserving expansion into detailed traces, without incurring heavy API loads.
acceptance_criteria: Micro-lens mockups for three breakpoints: list-inline (compact), rail (narrow), modal preview (expanded)

Chart specs defined for: latency distribution (P50/P95 P99 + violin/box), throughput sparkline (1m/5m/1h rollups), token waterfall (prompt vs. completion vs. system), and cost attribution stacked bars
Interaction spec: hover tooltips, tap-to-expand, compare two model versions, and 'pin baseline' overlay for rollouts
Prototype link with working timeframe selector and drill-to-full-dashboard transition
Performance constraints: initial payload <= 12KB, single aggregated endpoint, and fall back to cached summary when live metrics are unavailable
Accessibility: contrast ratios validated, keyboard focus order defined, ARIA labels for charts and toggles
design_notes: Tile layout: left column shows title, SLA badge, small sparkline of throughput; right column shows P50/P95 numeric badges and a micro-violin icon. Tap opens expansion with full token waterfall and cost stack.
Color semantics: use neutral-to-alert ramp tied to SLA thresholds from console config; avoid red unless SLA breached to prevent alarm fatigue.
Data aggregation: default to 5m rollups with option for 1m for interactive mode. For long ranges, compute downsampled percentiles and median-of-medians to maintain small payloads.
Tooltips: compact summary + link to sample traces (IDs) that respect PII masking rules. Tooltips should include window aggregation, sample count, and change vs. baseline percent.
Anomaly indicators: small triangular badge with micro sparkline overlay when significant drift detected; clicking opens anomaly details panel.
Cost attribution: show tokens split into prompt/system/completion and map to cost per-token using model price tiers; show estimated savings from caching/quantization as a projected delta.

Rollout overlay: when a canary is active, micro-lens shows two sparklines stacked and a toggle to switch baseline to canary; allow quick 'promote' CTA if metrics meet guardrails (handled by backend flow).
chart_specs: Latency distribution: violin plot with P50, P90, P95, P99 markers. X-axis: latency ms (log-scaled for >2000ms). Tooltip: percentile value, sample count, timeframe. Data window: 5m default, 1m interactive.
Throughput sparkline: area line showing requests per second with 1m/5m/1h rollups. Hover shows value and relative delta vs baseline. Visual smoothing: 3-point exponential moving average option.

Token waterfall: stacked bar showing prompt, system, completion token counts per request bucket; hover exposes median/95th tokens and example prompt length distribution. Aggregation window: 10-minute buckets for micro-lens.

Cost attribution: stacked bar with token components mapped to USD using model pricing. Bars show current cost and projected cost with suggested optimizations (caching/quantization). Tooltip includes savings estimate and link to Optimize recommendations.
Microtrace swimlane (optional): lightweight row that shows error spikes and tail latency events as dots across time. Click maps to trace ID list.
Chart accessibility: all charts must export textual summaries on request (ARIA live region) and provide CSV download of shown aggregated points.
interaction_flow: Default closed tile: shows route name, model name, SLA status color, throughput sparkline, P50 numeric, and a chevron.
Tap/click opens inline expansion above the list (context preserved). Expansion shows full token waterfall, latency violin, and action bar (Compare, Pin baseline, Open full dashboard).
Compare flow: select secondary model/version via quick pick. Micro-lens overlays secondary sparklines and highlights percent deltas with green/red micro-badges.
Baseline pin: user can pin a baseline time window or model version. Baseline overlay is dashed and semi-transparent to avoid visual clutter.
Fallback: if metrics endpoint returns partial data, show low-fidelity cached summary with a 'live unavailable' badge and option to retry.
